decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly play powerful artifact creatures and create a strong board presence through generating thopter tokens. By utilizing synergy between cards like Sai, Master Thopterist, Urza, Lord High Artificer, and Thopter Foundry, the deck can overwhelm opponents with a swarm of flying creatures. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Force of Will to protect its key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Urza's Saga and various artifact lands provide additional utility and ramp to accelerate the deck's game plan.

The main focus of this Bant Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy while also generating incremental advantage through card draw and recursion. The deck utilizes powerful control elements such as Force of Will, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Terminus to handle threats efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Snapcaster Mage allows for flexibility and resilience in various game states. The deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can stabilize and win through cards like Entreat the Angels or Jace, the Mind Sculptor.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo as quickly as possible to win the game. This combo involves using Cephalid Illusionist with Nomads en-Kor to mill your library, then Dread Return a Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck includes various ways to protect the combo, such as Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as ways to search for combo pieces like Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares to control the opponent's board.

The deck focuses on assembling a quick combo utilizing Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and Narcomoeba to win the game. It includes efficient disruption spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo. The deck also includes card selection and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find key combo pieces quickly. It includes a small toolbox of cards like Prismatic Ending and Teferi, Time Raveler for flexibility and interaction. Urza's Saga serves as a versatile tutor and mana source, while Thassa's Oracle provides an alternate win condition.

This deck aims to quickly combo off by using Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to mill the library, then use Dread Return to reanimate Thassa's Oracle for the win. The deck includes protection with Force of Will and disruption with Swords to Plowshares, as well as card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and the potential for tutor, while the mana base includes a mix of fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana production. The deck's strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces efficiently while controlling the game tempo.

The deck focuses on using disruptive creatures and removal spells to control the opponent's board while applying pressure with evasive threats. It utilizes Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play, along with Stoneforge Mystic to fetch powerful equipment. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and close out the game quickly with a combination of efficient creatures and removal spells.

The main idea of this Death & Taxes aggro deck is to disrupt opponent's strategy by utilizing cards that restrict their options while also applying pressure with efficient creatures. The deck focuses on playing disruptive creatures like Spirit of the Labyrinth and Skyclave Apparition, combined with powerful equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat to close out the game quickly. With the help of Aether Vial and cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard, the deck can assemble its pieces rapidly and overwhelm opponents with a combination of disruption and aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game tempo by utilizing disruptive and removal spells while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. Using cards like Force of Will, Daze, Fatal Push, and Hymn to Tourach, along with creatures like Brazen Borrower, Murktide Regent, and Nethergoyf, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while chipping away at their life total. The deck also includes card draw and selection with Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as graveyard hate with Nihil Spellbomb. The land base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and to disrupt the opponent's mana base with Wasteland.

The key concept of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Force of Will, along with tempo plays like Brazen Borrower and Daze, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and utility, while creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Floodpits Drowner offer additional threats. The deck also has disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy while also putting pressure on them with efficient creatures. It also includes powerful tempo plays with cards like Daze and Brazen Borrower. The key strategy of this deck is to use the powerful combo card Doomsday to stack the top of your library with specific cards like Thassa's Oracle and Street Wraith. By efficiently managing your resources and controlling the game with counterspells like Force of Will and cheap interaction like Fatal Push, you can set up a game-winning Doomsday pile that allows you to win the game on the spot. The deck also includes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces and disruption like Thoughtseize to protect your game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Doomsday combo to quickly and efficiently win the game. By utilizing various cards like Street Wraith, Thassa's Oracle, and Psychic Frog, you are able to set up your deck in a way that guarantees a win condition. This combo is supported by cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to help accelerate your plays. Additionally, cards like Force of Will and Daze help protect your combo from disruption. The deck also includes some control elements like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt your opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp into powerful dragon creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive spells such as Blood Moon, Sundering Eruption, and Broadside Bombardiers. By utilizing fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, along with efficient creatures like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Pyrogoyf, the deck aims to quickly overpower the opponent and close out the game before they can establish a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker further enhance the deck's ability to pressure the opponent and maintain a dominant position on the battlefield.

The main concept of this Aggro - Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to cast powerful creatures and spells like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Blood Moon. By disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Ghost Vacuum and Shatterskull Smashing, this deck aims to control the game and deal quick, aggressive damage with dragons and other powerful creatures. The combination of fast mana acceleration and disruptive elements makes this deck a formidable force in the Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently play aggressive Eldrazi creatures while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void. The key concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths using cards like Lotus Petal and Grim Monolith.
